text: Use a single trusted record for live bids.

A synchronous auction needs one authoritative decision maker for each room. Before accepting a bid, check authority, lot, price and deadline. Record an accepted bid as one atomic action. Recovering browsers should read that committed history. Repeated or delayed messages must not create duplicate purchases.

items: Illustration: When bids collide, accept only an offer still valid at commitment. Clearly reject the other.

text: Treat acceptance as a checked and durably recorded event, not a screen animation.
A successful browser animation does not prove a transaction was saved.
